net.proxy_sub: Used for tidebot's own requests (update checks, provider tests, plugins) and for Claude Code. Precedence: manual setting here > environment > system proxy.
net.url_hint: http://, https:// or socks5:// (Clash is usually http://127.0.0.1:7890). user:pass@ is allowed.
net.eff_pac: Direct. Your system uses a PAC script, which tidebot doesn't evaluate; choose Manual and enter the proxy.
net.mirrors_sub: Tried in order when GitHub can't be reached. The manifest is ed25519-signed and every package is sha256-checked, so a mirror can't alter anything; at worst the download fails.
net.presets_note: Third-party GitHub proxies, off by default; they see your IP and what you download and may disappear.
net.e.timeout: Timed out: GitHub can't be reached.
net.e.signature: Update manifest signature is invalid; rejected.
net.e.checksum: Downloaded file failed its checksum; discarded.
net.h.timeout: You probably need a proxy. In Settings → Network pick Auto / system (reads your OS proxy) or enter one manually, then Test. You can also add a download mirror.
net.h.dns: Check your connection; if you use a proxy, set it in Settings → Network.
net.h.tls: A corporate network or proxy may be intercepting HTTPS. Try another network or set a proxy in Settings → Network.
net.h.proxy: The proxy address is wrong or the proxy app isn't running. Check host and port in Settings → Network.
net.h.refused: A network or firewall blocked it. Try a proxy or a mirror.
net.h.http_404: The mirror may not have this version yet. Try later or download manually.
net.h.http: Try again later; if it keeps failing, download manually.
net.h.signature: Nothing unsigned gets installed. The mirror or network may be tampering; switch route or download manually.
net.h.checksum: Nothing that fails its checksum gets installed. Try another mirror or download manually.
net.h.unknown: See the technical details; set a proxy in Settings → Network or download manually.
